entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Nobleman of Urborg tormented by a family curse and bound to the angel Selenia.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: Guardian angel bound to Crovax through an enchanted heirloom.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Dark manipulator who commanded the forces of Rath.

entities.name: Morinfen
entities.description: Monstrous horror of Rath, killed by Selenia.

entities.name: Gallowbraid
entities.description: Monstrous horror of Rath who slew Rofellos; killed by Selenia.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Weatherlight captain who abandoned the quest after the attack.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Led the Weatherlight crew to Crovax's home.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Crew member vindicated in distrust of Gerrard's leadership.

entities.name: Attack on Crovax's Estate
entities.description: Rathi assault on Crovax's estate in 4201 AR.

events.summary: Crovax tried to free Selenia aboard the Weatherlight, but his father's second relic drew her back to Urborg.
events.quote: his father had crafted a second relic, binding Selenia anew

events.summary: Volrath's horrors descended on the manor and the Weatherlight crew joined the battle.
events.quote: As Volrath’s horrors descended upon the manor

events.summary: Gallowbraid slew Rofellos; Crovax's father and brother Jolav were also slain.
Crovax summoned Selenia, who killed Morinfen and Gallowbraid and scattered the invaders.
events.quote: Selenia fought valiantly, scattering the Rathi invaders and killing Morinfen and Gallowbraid

events.summary: Crovax destroyed the summoning crystal and cast Selenia back into Rath.
events.quote: Crovax inadvertently cast Selenia back into Rath

events.summary: Gerrard abandoned the Weatherlight and the Legacy quest.
events.quote: Gerrard abandoned the Weatherlight and the Legacy quest
